items.desc_now: A DeepSeek Harness plugin: paste text, drop a file, or paste a screenshot to translate; proofread the result side by side with the source; let a second model score it and rewrite what it criticises; and process a whole folder of documents from the workspace drawer.
items.desc_prev: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds a translation workspace to the Web GUI: translate text, an image, or a whole file, compare source and translation segment by segment, edit the output, switch the model per session, and keep every document on this device.
